title: 9:16 vertical photorealistic candid digi
prompt:
9:16 vertical photorealistic candid digicam photo, one single standalone image, two clearly adult East Asian women in their early 20s during a chaotic late-night apartment afterparty, intimate tipsy atmosphere, dreamy messy drunken snapshot.

Camera extremely close to the subjects, handheld 28mm compact digital camera, slightly tilted framing, imperfect composition, one woman very close to the lens reaching her hand toward the camera, hand and wine glass heavily enlarged by perspective, the second woman leaning behind her on a sofa, sleepy, laughing softly or resting against her shoulder.

Both women have messy slightly damp dark hair with loose strands covering the face, flushed cheeks, glossy lips, watery half-lidded eyes, soft smudged makeup, warm pink skin, visibly tipsy and emotionally loose. Clothing is casual feminine homewear, lace-trim camisole, loose cardigan slipping casually from the shoulders, soft lounge shorts, tasteful and non-explicit.

Make the drunken visual distortion much stronger: heavy long-exposure motion blur, multiple ghosted hand trails, doubled facial edges, light streaks, dragged shutter, smeared highlights, slight double exposure, prism refraction, chromatic aberration, foreground glass distortion, dreamy bloom, halation, soft haze, overexposed candle flares, imperfect focus, strong lens flare, subtle camera shake.

Foreground packed with blurred wine bottles, half-filled glasses, empty cups, instant noodle containers, tissues, scattered Polaroids, ashtray-like dish, blankets and late-night clutter, several objects extremely close to the lens becoming large abstract glowing shapes. Background contains large windows with defocused city lights, blue-purple neon reflections and warm amber lamps.

Add sparse handwritten diary-style text floating naturally around the empty areas, thin imperfect handwriting:
“Drunk but Happy ♡”
“谢谢你，陪我胡闹。”
“Girls Just Wanna Have Fun ♡”
“Same Night, Different Us ♡”

Add a small orange early-2000s digital timestamp near the bottom corner:
'25 03 08
02:47 AM

Color palette: dusty rose, wine red, warm amber, smoky purple, soft blue city lights. Early-2000s Asian compact-camera nightlife aesthetic, raw emotional snapshot, soft film grain, low contrast, lifted blacks, faded colors, dreamy drunken memory, imperfect, spontaneous, chaotic, sensual but tasteful, no collage, no split screen.
